chunks: And from him, from Al-Hasan ibn Muhammad ibn 'Allan, from Humayd ibn Ziyad, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Rabah, from Muhammad ibn Yazid ibn al-Mutawakkil, who said: He narrated to me Ahmad ibn al-Fadl, from Ali ibn Yahya, from Muhammad ibn Ishaq ibn 'Ammar, from Muhammad ibn Hakim, from Abu al-Hasan (peace be upon him), who said:
"Whoever visits the grave of Al-Husayn (peace be upon him) three times during the year will be safe from poverty."
ai.seo_question: What is the benefit of visiting Imam Husayn's grave three times a year?
ai.summary: Recorded in Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, this hadith from Imam al-Rida (peace be upon him) links the spiritual act of Ziyarat to material well-being, specifically protection from poverty. In Shia tradition, this 'poverty' is often interpreted not merely as financial lack but as the spiritual poverty of the soul, emphasizing that frequent visitation to the shrine of Imam Al-Husayn serves as a means of divine sustenance and relief from worldly deprivation.
